topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: I walked past the glass door, and there it was, a sign that didn't seem to belong: "Going Out of Business." The place where Friday nights came alive with the sizzle of the grill and the laughter of friends, now faces an uncertain twilight. I always thought it would be here, a constant in a city that changes too fast. My steps slowed as I read the details, planning a final visit to soak in every detail, from the worn leather of the booths to the familiar scent of garlic and herbs lingering in the air. It’s a strange mix of moments, looking back and forward, all at once.
